errors.evidence: The orange sector is not the second largest; it is tied for the largest with the red sector, as they both represent 36.4%. Stating it is the second largest is confusing.

errors.text_span: Останалите четири сектора – син, лилав, тюркоазен и тъмносин
errors.evidence: The description claims there are four remaining sectors, but there are only three (blue, purple, turquoise). It also invents a "тъмносин" (dark blue) sector that does not exist in the chart.
The description fails to mention that the green sector, representing "От 16 до 30 години", is also labeled with its percentage (13.6%).

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени в кръговата диаграма в низходящ ред по размер, като най-големите сектори са разположени в горната част, а по-малките са разположени в долната част.
errors.evidence: The slices of the pie chart are not arranged in descending order by size. For example, going clockwise from the bottom right, the order is small, large (36.4%), large (36.4%), medium (13.6%), small, small. This is not a descending order.
